submission.justification: S1 at 50% efficiency gives the highest expected significance in my scan: 4.15 sigma, against 3.49 for S3 and 2.56 for S2. S1 at 40% gave 3.91 and at 60% gave 3.96, so 50% is the peak among the points I tried. Statistical uncertainty only. I found no data/MC validation-region result in any project document, so I could not check the hard 10% mismodelling requirement for any strategy. This recommendation is conditional on that check. S1 uses jet substructure variables, which are often poorly modelled, so they are the first thing to check. If the substructure variables exceed 10%, fall back to S3 (3.49 sigma at 50%), which uses kinematic variables only. Check the validation region before the selection freeze.

requirements.evidence: S1 at 50% gives 4.15 sigma, the highest of the three strategies. S3 gave 3.49 and S2 gave 2.56 at 50%. Statistical uncertainty only. I scanned only 40, 50 and 60% for S1 and S3.

requirements.requirement: Data/MC disagreement in the signal-free validation region at most 10% for the variables used
requirements.evidence: None of the project documents (candidate_specs, samples, trigger, schedule, meeting notes, 2025 summary) contains validation-region data/MC results, and the simulation tool does not provide them. This must be checked before adopting S1, especially for the jet substructure inputs.

requirements.requirement: Strategy is one of the three in candidate_specs.md
